examples.text: A lo mejor nos podemos ayudar mutuamente.
examples.en: Maybe we can help each other out.
Both of my parents love each other.

examples.text: Los dos hombres se acusaron mutuamente.
examples.en: The two men accused each other.

examples.text: Ellos se comunican mutuamente por correo.
examples.en: They communicate with each other by mail.

examples.text: Yo sé que ellos se aman mutuamente.
examples.en: I know they're in love with each other.
